---
title: Frontend improvements: search, filter, pagination
labels: enhancement, frontend, ui
---

Improve the web UI for students and admins with search, filtering, and pagination.

Description
- Add search and filter options on the activities list (by name, schedule, availability).
- Add pagination if activity list grows.
- Improve visual design and mobile responsiveness of `src/static` pages.

Acceptance criteria
- Activities page supports search and filters.
- Pagination exists for long lists.
- UI is responsive on mobile screens.

Notes
- Can be implemented incrementally; consider lightweight client-side filtering first.
